project.name: Numou Ecosystem - Aggregator
project.description:
Phase 1 ecosystem layer (Docs/Plan/base00.md §2/§13, base01.md §P1-06..P1-09).
Numou is not an ERP with an FMS attached - it is a business ecosystem platform. This module owns the ecosystem vocabulary:
participant an entity taking part in the ecosystem provider a participant that supplies a capability capability something a participant can provide or consume relationship commercial/operational links between participants contract the agreed terms of a relationship
The critical abstraction is NOT FleetService. It is "transportation capability", satisfiable by an internal fleet, a Numou-hosted fleet, a 3PL, a carrier, a courier, an independent driver, or an external logistics platform - all first-class participants.
